messages:
sara_support: Received a ticket from AcmeCorp — multiple users report 403s when opening Billing -> Invoices. They say it started after a maintenance window last night. Can we triage? :thinking:
jamal_eng: @sara_support can you paste the tenant id and a sample user id?
sara_support: Tenant: acme-prod-17, sample user: alice@acme.com. Customer attached a screenshot: console shows "You do not have permission to view billing" and a request id.
maya_sec: tagging in sec. Any policy changes pushed yesterday? I remember a role cleanup PR targeted billing scopes. :eyes:
liam_infra: I can see a deploy at 02:13 UTC yesterday: "rbac/roles-refactor v2.4.2" — rollout to 50% of tenants then full. Rolling back now would be heavy; prefer targeted fix.
opsbot: audit-log: [1775550100] role_binding_update by jamal_eng for role: billing_viewer on tenant: acme-prod-17
jamal_eng: ok pulling audit logs for alice@acme.com...
jamal_eng: found 403 trace in logs: `permission_denied: resource:billing.invoices.view, reason: missing_permission` — but the role binding shows `role: billing_reader` bound to group `acme:finance`.
maya_sec: can you dump the role definition for `billing_reader`? Might have been renamed or trimmed of a scope.
jamal_eng: role dump:
```
role: billing_reader
scopes: [billing.summary.view, invoices.list]
# note: invoices.view was removed in v2.4.2
```
maya_sec: there it is — `invoices.view` got removed in the refactor because we consolidated to `invoices.list` which is read-list only. UI uses `invoices.view` guard for the individual invoice detail page. That mismatch would cause the 403s.
sara_support: so the fix is to reintroduce `invoices.view` into that role? or map the UI to the new scope?
jamal_eng: fastest is patching role to include `invoices.view` for now, then add an acceptance test and update UI guards. I'll prepare a hotfix.
liam_infra: before we change roles, confirm whether any compliance/KMS dependencies rely on the trimmed scope. The change initially came from a compliance review where we wanted to limit per-invoice attachment access.
maya_sec: checked KMS audit: no key policy changes. This is just RBAC scope mismatch. No KMS impact.
sara_support: customer wants ETA; can we restore access within the hour?
jamal_eng: patch PR: `rbac/role-fix/acme-invoice-scope` opened, small change. rolling to canary tenant list now (5 tenants) then acme.
opsbot: deploy started: rbac-service v1.9.7 -> 02:35 UTC
jamal_eng: canary passed for 5 tenants. Applying to acme-prod-17 now.
opsbot: role-update event: [1775554300] applied to tenant: acme-prod-17
sara_support: Acme reports alice can open invoices now. :white_check_mark: They confirmed 3 users tested.
maya_sec: following up — we should add a QA smoke that hits billing.detail endpoints after RBAC changes. Also add a small audit alert when a role removes scopes that are referenced by UI guards.
liam_infra: agree. I'll file an infra ticket to add the smoke test and an audit rule.
jamal_eng: filing follow-up PR to reconcile role names and update docs. Will include changelog and link to this thread.
sara_support: closing ticket after customer's confirmation. Thanks team. :tada:
jamal_eng: note for postmortem: avoid blanket scope removals without cross-checking UI permission checks and per-tenant feature flags.
maya_sec: adding a short incident blurb to security slack and marking as low-severity access regression with owner jamal_eng.
